stem: A 4-year-old boy is evaluated for his first generalized tonic-clonic seizure, which lasted 2 minutes. There is no history of illness or fever, and findings on examination an hour after the seizure are completely normal. His blood glucose is 5.8. The most appropriate initial management is:

options.text: Admit the child for a full septic work-up
Request an urgent CT of the brain

explanation: In a neurologically normal child with a first unprovoked brief generalized seizure and normal recovery, the initial approach is outpatient assessment, typically including EEG, rather than immediate admission, antiseizure treatment, or urgent neuroimaging.
rationale: This is a first unprovoked seizure with normal examination and normal glucose; outpatient EEG is the best initial management step.

optionExplanations.A: No features suggest sepsis or CNS infection.
optionExplanations.B: Long-term antiseizure medication is not usually started after a single brief unprovoked seizure.
optionExplanations.C: EEG is the appropriate initial investigation to help classify seizure type and estimate recurrence risk.
optionExplanations.D: Urgent CT is not indicated without focal deficits, trauma, persistent altered consciousness, or other red flags.

Instructions

Question 4 - 6 relate to this quiz

Case 2

A 5-year old girl is brought in by her mother to see you because her teacher has been concerned that she has been having ‘day-dreams’ in choir practise and also during class. Her mother has also noted ‘day dreams’ which have been occurring mid-sentence associated with staring off in the distance. The ‘day dreams’ last a few seconds and then she is back to normal and continues on with her sentence. She doesn’t fall and doesn’t get sleepy after the events. She has no colour change. The girl is otherwise developmentally normal and got a good mid-year report from school. On examination her height and weight are on the 75

th

centile. She has a completely normal examination. You get the patient to blow up a balloon in your office and she has a staring spell that lasts 5seconds before she completely recovers.
